faqs.q: Where can I find information about Fisheries and Forestry?
faqs.a: Fisheries and Forestry is part of the Primary Industries and Regional Development, Department of.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a recreational fishing licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a recreational fishing licence for 1-year or 3-year periods, or for 3-day or 1-month periods.

faqs.q: What can I do with my existing fishing licence?
faqs.a: You can renew, replace, or change details on your recreational fishing licence, such as contact details or name.

faqs.q: Do I need to report illegal fishing?
faqs.a: Yes, there is a process to report illegal fishing.
